QF.id: AIFM Fund Monitoring, Reporting, and Exit_14

question.text: Hampi Capital seeks 75% LP approval for in-specie distribution of an unliquidated IT-services investment. SEBI's April-2024 circular requires the manager to arrange a BID for the asset of at least:

answer.text: 10% of the value of unliquidated investments, to fund dissenters
25% of the value of unliquidated investments, for dissenter and pro-rata exits
50% of the value of unliquidated investments, for optional exits
100% of the value, since a cash exit must be fully available

explanation.text: The Logic: Following 75% investor approval for in-specie distribution, the AIF or its manager must arrange bids for a minimum of 25% of the value of unliquidated investments. Dissenting investors get priority to exit using this bid; any unsubscribed portion is then offered pro-rata to non-dissenting investors. The Trap: 10%, 50% and 100% are distractors; the prescribed minimum threshold is 25%. Note: If the manager fails to arrange the 25% bid, the in-specie distribution is recorded at a nominal value of INR 1 for track-record purposes.
